title: Session: 2.15.0 reply-session fixes and the guest-application switch
objective: Validate 2.15.0 on DevBot after migration 006 and command re-registration: each 2.14.0 reply-session decision (D1–D9) works live. FC tags show once, repeats reply = NO CHANGE, every option has an Example, member options suggest server members, a re-link becomes the main, the owner's nickname is skipped, guest applications have their own switch, and /officer reset and /guest reset return to the automatic rules.
user: Approve the rollout and command registration; `/config show` and `/config validate` show the FC tag once.
`/main` on your main; `/nickname enabled:true` twice, `enabled:false` twice; `/config officer_rank rank:Officer`. Repeats are = NO CHANGE.
`/ledger adjust` with `entry:5`, `entry:#5` and an unknown entry; `/sync status run_id:nope`. Failures show an Example.
Type names into every `member:` option; as a non-officer, `/characters member:` someone else.
A tester with no link left re-links: the character becomes their main and, with sync on, their nickname.
`/config guest_applications enabled:false`, `/apply` as a member, `enabled:true` twice; `channel:` with `unset_channel:true` is refused.
`enabled:false channel:` a scratch channel, delete it: `enabled:true` is refused; `enabled:true channel:#officer-chat` reopens.
`/officer reset member:PigeonMuffin` restores his rank access; repeat it; a manager below the Officer role is refused. `/guest reset` a member, check `/guest status`.
assistant: Roll out with the owner's go-ahead: stop, back up, restore and `check-restore.js --schema-version 005_launch_access_policy.sql`, `migrate.js --restore-rehearsal`, then migrate `tarubot_dev` and deploy.
Register guild commands; `commands.js list` reads 19 roots / 43 paths and no /config option is named clear.
Check readiness and `writerLease`, no warn or error lines and no blocked job after the owner's `/nickname`; `guest_applications_enabled` is true for DevBot and 006 left revision 13 unchanged.

Compare replies with REPLIES.md and the D1–D9 decisions (the FC tag once in ledger footers too); match Refs and Codes to the log; NO CHANGE repeats and the refused `enabled:true` save, audit and queue nothing.
Confirm `/guest reset` keeps ended grants as history and `/officer reset` leaves no override; record results in docs/DEV_GUILD.md.
bot: Run compiled 2.15.0 on schema 006; guest applications stay open on DevBot because a review channel was set.
Suggest server members on every member option from the member cache, then Discord's member search.
Skip the server owner's nickname instead of blocking the job; make a new link the main when there's no main and no other active link.
Validate a newly named review channel, and the stored one when applications switch on; switching off alone checks nothing.
Reconcile the member after each reset; officer notices stay plain text until 2.16.0.
Post this responsibility-separated session plan in #chat.
